verdict.rationale: Firebase offers Gemini in Firebase, a natural-language chat interface in the console for answering questions, generating code, and troubleshooting. Its official MCP server also lets AI clients such as Claude Code, Cursor and VS Code Copilot create and manage projects, manage Auth users, and work with Firestore data from natural-language prompts. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of NL-driven operation, evidence that the in-console Gemini chat can execute operations rather than only advise and generate code, and documentation of how much of the product surface is covered beyond the listed MCP capabilities (operational control otherwise depends on an external MCP client).
